tensura.skill.fusionist.description:
Turn blocks into matter, then spend it on explosions.
[Disassemble] *press*: break the block you aim at (5 blocks). *Sneak+press* with a block in hand: convert it. Both give matter.
[Fuse] *press*: mine, 5 matter, 300 damage (500 mastered). Mastered: *press* your own mine to grow it (10 matter).
[Stone] *press*: blast shot, 1 matter, 6-block radius.
tensura.skill.gluttony.description:
Devouring mist (50 damage, 10 blocks; 15 mastered) that steals skills and EP.
[Predation] *press*: mist; *sneak+press*: set Blocks/Fluid/All/None. [Stomach] *press*: storage. [Isolation] *press*: remove effects, 200 magicule.
[Corrosion] *hold*: 10 damage to all within 5. [Receive] *press* a subordinate: copy its skills.
[Mimicry] and [Provide]: not implemented.
tensura.skill.godly_craftsman.descriptio:
Engrave enchantments on gear; bonus levels up to +2 over normal.
*Press*: spatial storage.
*Sneak+press*: engraving menu.
Engraving can leave a curse.
tensura.skill.gourmand.description:
Your hits can steal EP (50% chance, 75% mastered). Raises max aura and magicule by 3% (7.5% mastered).
*Press* to toggle.
*Press* a target in reach: eat its heart for EP; it needs Fear (not fully checked).
tensura.skill.great_sage.description:
Chant speed ×2 and faster learning while on.
*Press* to toggle.
[Analytical Appraisal] *press*: scan within 15 blocks (25 mastered). *Sneak+press*: entities/blocks/both.
[Analysis] *press*: copy a skill from a target in 10 blocks (30 for magic), 25% (50% mastered).
[Refining] *press*: crafting menu. *Sneak+press*: refining menu.
tensura.skill.greed.description:
Take over minds and force kills.
[Spiritual Domination] *hold* on a target (30 blocks) to charge control: players 60s, mobs 90s; closer is faster. *Sneak+press*: release it.
[Greed Flare] *press*: boost you (+5%) and allies (+2.5%) within 20 blocks. Exact effect not checked.
[Death Wish] *hold 10s*: target takes its max HP in damage. 1,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.guardian.description:
Allies within 25 blocks get Guarded for 180s: +10 armor and 30 barrier. 100 magicule.
[Grant Protection] *press*.
[Iron Wall] *press*: you gain armor +15 (+40 mastered) and knockback resistance.
tensura.skill.healer.description:
Heal by touch or spread Infection (45s).
[Heal] *press*: heal yourself. *Sneak+press*: heal a target within 5 blocks. Costs 80 magicule per HP (40 mastered).
[Infection] *press* at a target: 200 magicule.
[Plague] *press*: infects all within 7 blocks.
tensura.skill.infinity_prison.descriptio:
{P}: spends 25 magicule to guard against some hits.
[Imprison] *press* at a target (30 blocks): Infinite Imprisonment for 300s (600 mastered). 50,000 magicule.
[Imaginary Space] *press*: spatial storage.
tensura.skill.lust.description:
Drain or restore life.
[Drain] *press* at a target within 5 blocks: Lust Drain for 10s, steals EP.
[Invigorate] *press*: heal you. *Sneak+press*: heal target; animals grow and breed.
[Embracing Drain] *press*: 5s drain, 500 magicule.
[Death Blessing] *hold 5s*: 3-block field at 10 blocks, 7,500 magicule. Exact effect not checked.
[Rebirth]: not implemented.
tensura.skill.martial_master.description:
Physical hits do ×1.5 damage. Dodge: 25% melee, 100% projectiles. Costs 100 aura.
*Press* to toggle.
*Press*: dash to where you aim (15 blocks, 20 mastered), hitting foes for 15 damage (75 mastered).
tensura.skill.mathematician.description:
Chant speed ×2, 75% crit chance, small dodge boost.
*Press* to toggle.
*Press*: scan within 5 blocks (15 mastered). *Sneak+press*: entities/blocks/both.
tensura.skill.merciless.description:
Drain the weak and the afraid.
[Soul Steal] *hold*: foes within 15 blocks that are afraid lose 10% HP and EP; weakened ones are killed. Not fully checked.
[Soul Consume]: your hits apply Soul Drain for 5s.
100 magicule.
tensura.skill.murderer.description:
Hides your presence (Concealment III) and mutes your sounds; +50 attack damage (150 mastered). 50 magicule.
*Hold* to stay hidden. Once mastered, *press* to toggle.
tensura.skill.musician.description:
Sound attacks that ignore armor.
[Sonic Blast] *press*: 75 damage in a line, 8 blocks (150, 12 mastered).
[Sound Wave] *press*: 40 damage within 5 blocks of you (75 mastered).
[Mind Requiem] *press*: 150 damage (+100 to spirits) in front, 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.observer.description:
{P}: dodge 20% melee, 100% projectiles.
[Danger Detection] warns when a mob targets you.
[Presence Detection] shows monsters, traps or treasure through walls. *Sneak+press*: switch what is shown.
*Press* to toggle.
tensura.skill.oppressor.description:
Control gravity.
[Repel] and [Attract] *hold*: push away (10 blocks) or pull (30); power builds up to 10. Number keys set power (mastered).
[Oppress] *press*: 100 damage (200 mastered), Oppression and Burden II for 30s.
[Bleve] *press*: same damage, launches the target.
[Flicker] *hold, release*: dash forward.
tensura.skill.predator.description:
Devouring mist, 10 damage at 3 blocks.
[Predation] *press*: mist. *Sneak+press*: set Blocks/Fluid/All/None.
[Analysis] *press*: refining menu. [Stomach] *press*: storage.
[Isolation] *press*: remove effects, 200 magicule.
[Mimicry]: not implemented.
tensura.skill.pride.description:
When a skill or effect hits you, copy it: 20% chance (100% mastered), then a 45s cooldown. Copies become sub-modes.
[Copy] *press* or *hold* uses the selected copy.
*Scroll*: passed to the copied skill (not checked).
tensura.skill.reaper.description:
Small form (×0.5 size): wider Presence Sense, 15% melee and projectile dodge (30 mastered).
*Press* to toggle.
[Attack] *press*: summon clones that copy your stats and skills. *Scroll*: how many (max 5).
[Infinite Eater] *press* a target (reach +3): kills it if its EP is lower, steals EP. Toggle off first.
tensura.skill.reflector.description:
Stores damage you take as echo, then fires it back.
[Echo Reflection] *press*: piercing echo shot, ×3 damage (×5 mastered). *Sneak+scroll*: its size.
[Echo Counter]: melee hits return ×2.5 damage, projectiles fly back faster. Movement locked until mastered.
tensura.skill.researcher.description:
Engrave enchantments on gear; bonus levels up to +1.
*Press*: spatial storage.
*Sneak+press*: engraving menu.
Engraving can leave a curse.
tensura.skill.reverser.description:
Flip things to their opposite.
[Alignment Reverse] *press* at a target within 3 blocks: flip chaos/order.
[Inverted Fusion] Buff: target's buffs become debuffs. Debuff: debuffs become buffs. *Press*.
Mastered: toggle to turn your debuffs into buffs; *press* an item to reverse curses (10,000 magicule).
tensura.skill.royal_beast.description:
Beast form for 180s (360 mastered): massive physical boost, health set to full. 60s cooldown.
*Press* to transform.
